name: HovenCast
author: Sean Hovenkamp
description: Turn a compatible TV into a wireless second monitor for Omarchy. Keep a workspace on your TV or share a screen, window or area with audio. Roku, Fire TV and Google Cast; Apple TV / AirPlay is experimental.
